trust_decision.summary: Client::parseKubeconfig decides the TLS trust options for the selected cluster: with no certificate-authority-data and an https server it emits verify=false, which turns off certificate verification even though the kubeconfig never asked for insecure-skip-tls-verify. setOptions stores that value and sendUpgradeRequest applies it as verify_peer/verify_peer_name.

landing_point.why: A search for 'verify' => false or for kubeconfig parsing in the only client class leads straight to the else-branch that disables verification.

fix_sites.module_kind: config_loader (kubeconfig parser in the core client class)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 setOptions route: 'setOptions merges by design and has a $reset flag (src/Client.php:145-158), so a stale verify=false from an earlier explicitly-insecure config is the caller's choice, not the kubeconfig parser bug the report describes.'

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An explicit cluster insecure-skip-tls-verify: true must still yield verify=false, and a kubeconfig with certificate-authority-data must yield ca_cert with no verify key. setOptions takes 'verify' in preference to 'ca_cert' (elseif), so a fix that always emits verify=true for https silently drops the CA, and the websocket path then never sets cafile.

O6_input_shapes: kubeconfig as YAML string (default contentType) - src/Client.php:220-228
kubeconfig file path via parseKubeconfigFile - src/Client.php:318-325
insecure-skip-tls-verify accepted only as strict boolean true (fix.diff:14); absent or non-bool keeps verification on

O7_producer.where: src/Client.php:197-311 (parseKubeconfig produces the options array consumed by setOptions src/Client.php:145-189 and sendUpgradeRequest src/Client.php:497-508)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Calling setOptions() again without reset (e.g. switching to a kubeconfig that has a CA) leaves an earlier verify=false in place: the new ca_cert is ignored because of the elseif, and the websocket TLS stays unverified.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Merge semantics plus an opt-in $reset flag. The report is about parseKubeconfig, not setOptions. The master-change branch already clears only the discovery cache (src/Client.php:160-163), which suggests that per-master state other than the cache is meant to persist.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 130 lines above the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: kubeconfig 'certificate-authority' (file path form, not -data) handled by a branch that falls back to verify=false when the file cannot be read
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The parser supports only *-data keys today; a maintainer adding the file-path forms (certificate-authority, client-certificate) could easily copy the old fail-open fallback.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sendUpgradeRequest disables verify_peer_name when tls-server-name/proxy-url is set, or falls back to verify=false on a cafile load error
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the only internal TLS consumer (exec/attach websocket in another code path from the HTTP client); a fallback on handshake errors is a common maintainer shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: constructor builds a default discovered HTTP client and maps $options['verify'] into it (e.g. a Guzzle verify option) using a separate truthiness rule from setOptions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Today only the websocket honours verify/ca_cert; wiring the same options into the default PSR-18 client would add a second implementation of the trust mapping.

O9_family: CWE-295 improper certificate validation (fail-open default in kubeconfig-to-TLS-options mapping)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/ClientTest.php (no kubeconfig/verify tests at the pinned commit; the fix adds two parseKubeconfig tests at fix.diff:108-136). parseKubeconfig is a pure static function, so it can be tested offline. The websocket TLS options at src/Client.php:497-508 are tested only through reflection or a mock.

j.j_sites_touched: src/Client.php (security). src/Models/Model.php and src/Collections/Collection.php are unrelated compatibility changes in the same commit.
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change line 299 to verify=true (or set verify=true for every https server). This drops honoured insecure-skip-tls-verify, and if it is also emitted alongside ca_cert, setOptions discards the CA.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit also changes src/Models/Model.php (JSON/YAML string constructor) and src/Collections/Collection.php (map override); these are compatibility changes unrelated to TLS.

getTempFilePath writes CA/client cert/key to fixed, shared names in sys_get_temp_dir (src/Client.php:330-341), so a second kubeconfig overwrites the first one's CA file (predictable temp file, CWE-377).
